fields.description: Field catalog: type, label and format per field. This is the hook for a semantic layer (dbt): generate it from the manifest and every chart gets consistent labels and formats without repeating them.

scales.description: `secondary`: the second value axis of a dual-axis chart, used by the layers that set `axis: 'secondary'` (two measures in different units: euros and a percentage, rain and temperature). It has its own domain; `x` / `y` stay the screen axes of the other layers. Named `secondary` rather than `y2` on purpose: `encode.y2` is already the end of a range, and on a horizontal chart the second value axis runs along x (it is drawn at the top).

projection.description: Draw on a map instead of cartesian axes: `x` is then a longitude field and `y` a latitude field, and the chart keeps the projection's aspect ratio.

axes.description: `secondary`: the axis of `scales.secondary`, drawn on the right (at the top of a horizontal chart) with its own graduations, title and format. The grid stays the primary axis' one.

autoCompact.description: On a small screen, give up the subtitle, then the axis titles, then the legend when the drawing would be cramped. Default true.

responsive.description: Rules by size, applied over the spec when the chart's box matches (the last matching rule wins). A rule's `spec` can change anything, the marks included: another chart on a phone. `[{ "maxWidth": 420, "spec": { "layers": [{ "mark": "bar", ... }] } }]`

annotations.description: Reference lines, bands and notes, in data coordinates (cartesian charts). `{ "y": 100, "text": "Objectif" }`, `{ "x": ["2024-03-01", "2024-04-15"], "text": "Campagne" }`, `{ "x": "2024-06-01", "y": 120, "text": "Lancement" }`.

legend.description: `false` hides the legend. By default it shows as soon as there are two entries, and the color ramp of a mark that provides one. `true` also asks for the ramp (theme ramp, both ends of the values) of a cartesian layer colored by a numeric field.

animation.description: Entry animation when the chart first appears: bars grow, lines draw, pies sweep open. `false` to turn it off, a number for its duration (ms). Skipped when the system asks for reduced motion. Default 900 ms.

facet.description: Small multiples: one panel per value of `field`, same scales, same colors, one shared legend. `columns` defaults to fitting the width; `height` is per panel (px, default 220).

description: The chart spec. Apart from `data` (which may hold typed arrays), it is plain JSON: it can be stored in a database, diffed, generated, and edited by a visual builder. Anything that needs a function goes in `ChartOptions`.

DataInput.description: Chart input. Columnar is the native form (what ClickHouse/Arrow produce); rows are accepted for convenience and converted once.

description.description: Free text from the catalog (dbt description); for editors and documentation, not drawn.

role.description: What the field means to every chart, declared once in the catalog (or in dbt's `meta.role`): `importance` ranks rows (which ones get a label first: a timeline's cards…), `link` holds the address a click opens. A chart uses it when its own encoding does not say otherwise.

absolute.description: Show magnitudes only (a population pyramid draws men as negatives).

FormatSpec.description: Serializable number format (lives in the spec, so no functions).

name.description: Series name when there is no color field. Defaults to the y field label.

data.description: Layer-specific data; defaults to the chart data.

geo.description: GeoJSON to draw (shape marks): a FeatureCollection, Feature or Geometry.

graph.description: Boxes and arrows (`flow` mark): a whole process, branches and loops included.

geoKey.description: Where a shape's join key and name live, e.g. `properties.iso_a3`. Default: `properties.name`, then `id`.

axis.description: Which value axis the layer reads: `primary` (default) or `secondary`, the second value axis (`scales.secondary`, `axes.secondary`), which has its own domain and is drawn on the right. Cartesian marks only; ignored when no layer is left on the primary axis. `{ "mark": "line", "axis": "secondary", "encode": { "x": "month", "y": "margin" } }`

stack.description: Stack series on top of each other (bar, area). `normalize`: each stack fills 100 %. `center`: stacks centered on zero (streamgraph).

transform.description: Reshape the layer's data before drawing (bin, aggregate, boxplot, waterfall, sort, regression).

style.description: Overrides `theme.marks[mark]` for this layer, plus `color` for a fixed color.

overrides.description: Restyle some marks only: the first matching rule wins. `{ when: { field: 'country', in: ['France', 'Italie'] }, style: { color: '#e34948' } }`

highlight.description: Put some values forward: they keep their color (or take `color`), the others fade to `dim` opacity. Works on every mark. `field` defaults to the layer's category (x, y on a horizontal chart, `key`, `color`, the first level of `path`, or `source`). `{ "values": ["France"], "color": "#e34948" }`

series.description: Style of one series (or one slice, one node…) by its name: a line in another color, thicker, dashed; its labels in their own ink. `{ "France": { "color": "#e34948", "width": 4, "labelColor": "#e34948" } }`

labels.description: Labels of this layer, whatever the mark: ink, size (as a factor), weight, a background pill.

link.description: Clicking a datum opens the address in `field` (`target` default `_blank`). The chart emits `link` first; `open: false` leaves the navigation to the app.

label.description: Text in the box; defaults to the id.

value.description: A figure shown under the label (count, duration…), formatted with `fields[valueField]` if given.

group.description: Groups color the boxes and form the legend (team, system…); with `style.lanes`, the swimlane of the node.

description.description: Extra text in the tooltip (and under the name in the pipeline look).

x.description: Position by hand (px, center of the node, from the top-left of the drawing). Unset: automatic placement.

value.description: Volume on the arrow: thickens it, shown in the tooltip.

x.description: Required by every cartesian mark; a longitude field under a projection.

y.description: Required by every cartesian mark; a latitude field under a projection.

x2.description: End of a range along x; `x` is then its start (Gantt bars, horizontal intervals).

y2.description: End of a range along y; `y` is then its start (waterfall, box plot, error bars).

key.description: Item identity: shape join key (maps), slice (pie), tile (treemap), stage (funnel), axis (radar).

value.description: Measure of marks that are not positioned on x / y: pie, treemap, funnel, gauge, radar, sankey, sunburst.

source.description: Flow start and end (sankey). Link ends (`bundle`; `color` is then the group of the source).

target.description: Also the goal of an indicator, one per row (`bullet`, `liquid`, `activity`, `led`).

path.description: Hierarchy, from the outermost level to the innermost (sunburst). The categorical dimensions, left to right (`parsets`).

time.description: The field that steps through time, one frame per value (bar chart race).

progress.description: Share done, 0 to 1 (or 0 to 100): the filled part of a `gantt` bar.

group.description: Phase of a task (`gantt`): each group opens with a summary bar spanning its tasks. Group of the `source` entity (`matrix`).

depends.description: Predecessors of a task (`gantt`): ids separated by commas, each drawn as an arrow from its end to this start.

id.description: Task identity that `depends` refers to (`gantt`), when it is not the `key` (names repeated or shortened).

color.description: Field name: a string field splits into series, a numeric field maps to the sequential ramp.

size.description: Field name (point marks): numeric field mapped to the size range.

angle.description: Direction in degrees, clockwise from up (`vector`); the angle of a polar mark, instead of `x` (`polarLine`, `polarScatter`, `radialArea`).

open.description: Opening and closing prices (`candlestick`; `y` is the high, `y2` the low).

previous.description: Value of the previous period, one per row (`barRank`: the tick on each bar, the change and the places moved).

type.description: Histogram bins: one row per bin (and per group), zero counts included. Outputs `bin_start`, `bin_end`, `bin_mid`, `count`.

maxbins.description: Target number of bins (rounded to a nice step). Default 20.

type.description: Running total for a waterfall: adds `start`, `end` and `kind` (`increase`, `decrease` or `total`). Rows whose label is in `totals` show the running total instead of adding to it.

total.description: Append a final total row with this label.

kinds.description: Rename the three kinds (they become legend entries).

type.description: Pareto analysis: rows sorted by `field`, largest first, plus the running share of the total. Outputs `cumulative` (from 0 to 1, `as` to rename it) and `share` (each row's own part of the total). Rows without a value go last.
Pearson correlation of every pair of `fields`: one row per pair, with `x` and `y` (the two field names) and `value` (from -1 to 1). Draw it as a heatmap (`style.diverging`).

labels.description: Names to show instead of the field keys, in the same order.

type.description: Density curve of `field`: kernel estimate (`kde`, default) or the fitted normal law (`normal`, a bell curve). Outputs `field` and `density`, on `steps` points spanning the data (± 3 standard deviations for `normal`). With `step` (the histogram's bin width), the curve is scaled to counts, so it can be drawn over a histogram.
Least-squares line through (x, y): two rows at the ends of the x range.

TransformSpec.description: Presentation transforms, applied to a layer's table before it is drawn. They are part of the spec, so they stay serializable. Heavy aggregation belongs in the database: these exist for shaping what the chart shows (binning a distribution, box-plot statistics, a running total).

type.description: Simple moving average of `field` over `period` rows. Outputs `as` (default `sma`).

groupby.description: One independent series per group (several tickers in one table).

type.description: Exponential moving average of `field` (weight 2 / (period + 1) on the latest row), seeded with the simple average of the first `period` rows. Outputs `as` (default `ema`).
Bollinger bands of `field`: `middle` (moving average over `period` rows), `upper` and `lower` (`k` standard deviations of the same window above and below).

k.description: Width of the bands, in standard deviations. Default 2.

type.description: Relative strength index of `field` (Wilder's smoothing), from 0 to 100: above 70 the price ran up fast, under 30 it fell fast. Outputs `as` (default `rsi`).
Moving average convergence / divergence of `field`: `macd` (fast EMA minus slow EMA), `signal` (EMA of that line) and `histogram` (their difference).
Heikin-Ashi candles: averaged prices that smooth the noise of a trend. The four fields are replaced in place (the same `candlestick` encoding then draws them), unless `as` names other outputs.

MarkStyle.description: Options of the mark (theme.marks[mark]) and `color`. Not checked by this schema: see Theme["marks"] in the TypeScript types.

Predicate.description: A condition on one field of a row. Several conditions in an array must all hold.

dim.description: Opacity of the other values. Default 0.25; 1 keeps them as they are.

color.description: Ink of every label (theme tokens allowed: `$ink`, `$1`…). Replaces the automatic contrast on colored fills.

scale.description: Size factor (1.2 = 20 % larger), so big center values stay bigger than the rest.

background.description: A rounded pill behind each label (`$surface` for the background color).

type.description: `band` over a date field gives an ordinal axis of dates: one band per date present in the data, in order, no room for the others (trading sessions without week-ends), with calendar graduations (sessions, weeks, months… as room allows).

domain.description: Explicit domain; `null` on one side keeps that side automatic.

nice.description: Extend the domain to round numbers.

zero.description: Force the domain to include zero.

reverse.description: Run the axis the other way: rank 1 at the top, first category at the bottom…

categories.description: Category order of a band axis (others follow in data order).

domain.description: Fixed entity -> slot order, so colors stay stable across charts and filters.

bounds.description: Visible extent as [[west, south], [east, north]] in degrees. Default: the inhabited world.

color.description: Ink of the graduations and of the title (theme tokens allowed: `$1`, `$muted`…). On a dual-axis chart, the color of a series on its axis says which one it reads on.

spec.description: Merged over the spec: objects merged deeply, `layers` merged layer by layer (a layer can change its mark).

fields.description: Field catalog: type, label and format per field. This is the hook for a semantic layer (dbt): generate it from the manifest and every chart gets consistent labels and formats without repeating them.

scales.description: `secondary`: the second value axis of a dual-axis chart, used by the layers that set `axis: 'secondary'` (two measures in different units: euros and a percentage, rain and temperature). It has its own domain; `x` / `y` stay the screen axes of the other layers. Named `secondary` rather than `y2` on purpose: `encode.y2` is already the end of a range, and on a horizontal chart the second value axis runs along x (it is drawn at the top).

projection.description: Draw on a map instead of cartesian axes: `x` is then a longitude field and `y` a latitude field, and the chart keeps the projection's aspect ratio.

axes.description: `secondary`: the axis of `scales.secondary`, drawn on the right (at the top of a horizontal chart) with its own graduations, title and format. The grid stays the primary axis' one.

autoCompact.description: On a small screen, give up the subtitle, then the axis titles, then the legend when the drawing would be cramped. Default true.

annotations.description: Reference lines, bands and notes, in data coordinates (cartesian charts). `{ "y": 100, "text": "Objectif" }`, `{ "x": ["2024-03-01", "2024-04-15"], "text": "Campagne" }`, `{ "x": "2024-06-01", "y": 120, "text": "Lancement" }`.

legend.description: `false` hides the legend. By default it shows as soon as there are two entries, and the color ramp of a mark that provides one. `true` also asks for the ramp (theme ramp, both ends of the values) of a cartesian layer colored by a numeric field.

animation.description: Entry animation when the chart first appears: bars grow, lines draw, pies sweep open. `false` to turn it off, a number for its duration (ms). Skipped when the system asks for reduced motion. Default 900 ms.

facet.description: Small multiples: one panel per value of `field`, same scales, same colors, one shared legend. `columns` defaults to fitting the width; `height` is per panel (px, default 220).

axis.description: Read the value on the secondary value axis of a dual-axis chart (an 80 % line on a Pareto chart).

color.description: Color or theme token (`$1`, `$muted`…). Lines default to `$muted`, bands to `$1`.

dash.description: Line dash in px; `[]` for a solid line. Default `[5, 4]`.

AnnotationSpec.description: One scalar: a line across the chart at that value. A pair: a band. Both x and y scalars: a note pinned to that point. `x` and `y` are screen axes.

AnnotationValue.description: A number, a date (ISO string or epoch ms) or a category name.

tooltip.description: Hover tooltip. `x` lists every series at the hovered x; `nearest` picks one mark.

fitY.description: Zoomed along x, the value axis fits what is visible. Default true.

zoom.description: Wheel to zoom, drag to pan, double-click to reset.

select.description: Drag to select marks: freehand `lasso` (default) or `rect`. Hold Shift to pan instead, Cmd/Ctrl to add to the selection; click empty space to clear.

legendToggle.description: Click a legend entry to toggle its series.

sync.description: Charts with the same group name hover at the same x and show the same x range: zoom one, the others follow (synchronized charts, a navigator).

navigator.description: This chart is a range navigator for its `sync` group: drag a window over it (or its edges) to set what the other charts show. Click to show everything.

player.description: Play button and scrubber for marks that play through time (`race`). Hide it for previews.
